nodes.asset_description: A minimal still-life of a white ceramic pour-over dripper on a glass carafe with dark coffee sits beside a small white milk pitcher. Set against a warm peach background with strong directional shadows, the clean white ceramics contrast crisply with the black base and deep brown coffee.

A flat-lay of coffee essentials features a bowl of roasted beans, two minimalist coffee bags, and a copper scoop on a pastel geometric backdrop of peach, pink, and yellow. The composition is clean and graphic, divided by white lines with crisp studio lighting and strong shadows.

A hand holds a white, matte coffee pouch with a pump dispenser labeled “Articnian Coffee” against a warm apricot backdrop. The minimalist, product-style shot uses strong directional light and a crisp shadow with ample negative space.

A minimalist flat lay of coffee gear on a warm peach background: a wood-and-metal hand grinder, white pour-over dripper, cup of black coffee with a sugar stick, an amber vial, and a labeled dark bottle. Strong directional light casts crisp shadows, highlighting neutral whites, browns, and metallic textures in a clean, airy composition.

A minimalist graphic shows a centered white diamond (a rotated square with slightly rounded corners) on a solid black background. The composition is symmetrical, high-contrast, and dominated by clean lines and negative space.
